# NX-OS NTP Integration Test

-- state/preload --
{
  "System": {
    "name": "device",
    "ch-items": {
      "model": "N9K-C93180YC-FX",
      "ser": "TEST123456"
    },
    "showversion-items": {
      "nxosVersion": "10.6(4)"
    },
    "procsys-items": {
      "bootTime": "1700000000"
    },
    "intf-items": {
      "phys-items": {
        "PhysIf-list": []
      }
    }
  }
}


-- ntp/config --
apiVersion: networking.metal.ironcore.dev/v1alpha1
kind: NTP
metadata:
  name: config
  namespace: default
  labels:
    networking.metal.ironcore.dev/device: device
spec:
  deviceRef:
    name: device
  adminState: Up
  sourceInterfaceName: mgmt0
  servers:
    - address: ntp.example.com
      prefer: true
      vrfName: management

-- state/expect --
{
  "System": {
    "name": "device",
    "ch-items": {
      "model": "N9K-C93180YC-FX",
      "ser": "TEST123456"
    },
    "showversion-items": {
      "nxosVersion": "10.6(4)"
    },
    "procsys-items": {
      "bootTime": "1700000000"
    },
    "fm-items": {
      "ntpd-items": {
        "adminSt": "enabled"
      }
    },
    "time-items": {
      "adminSt": "enabled",
      "logging": "disabled",
      "prov-items": {
        "NtpProvider-list": [
          {
            "keyId": 0,
            "maxPoll": 6,
            "minPoll": 4,

            "preferred": true,
            "provT": "server",
            "vrf": "management"
          }
        ]
      },
      "srcIf-items": {
        "srcIf": "mgmt0"
      }
    },
    "procsys-items": {
      "bootTime": "1700000000"
    }
  }
}
